milestone.title: Floating milestone picker: anchored overlay with multi-select, narrow-terminal modal fallback, 100ms Start-pulse

intent.outcome: The milestone selection workflow becomes a floating center overlay (anchored to the middle 2/3 of the screen) with multi-select via checkboxes. On terminals narrower than 100 cols the same internal state renders as a full-screen modal. After Confirm, the Start button does a 100ms cyan pulse to register the click before the screen flips to While-Executing (M241).

problem.description: Today the milestone picker lives inside the milestone lane (M207) as a sub-pane that takes the full tab — or, in the predecessor option drafts (autopilot-draft/option01 etc.), as a modal that covers the whole screen. The 2026-09-26 audit surfaced a new requirement: pickers should be floating (not full-screen), multi-select via checkbox (not radio), and bounded by a 30% dimmed backdrop. The picker needs to share state with the run config so that Confirm commits the same selection to .mp/autopilot-state.json::setup.milestones. On narrow terminals (<100 cols), a backdrop overlay doesn't fit — the picker must collapse to a full-screen modal at the same renderer level, sharing internal state. After Confirm, the user needs feedback that the click registered before the While-Executing screen takes over (~250-500ms latency); a 100ms cyan pulse on the Start button does it without visual noise.

in_scope: Floating picker overlay widget — anchored to the middle 2/3 of the screen (horizontally and vertically); backdrop dims the surrounding setup + sidebar to 30% opacity.
Multi-select backend — checkbox toggle; selection stored as Vec<MilestoneSummary>; persists across filter changes (a milestone selected under 'ready-only' stays selected when you switch to 'all').
Filter chip row: 4 mutually-exclusive chips (all / ready-only / in-progress / complete).
Search box with '/' focus: filters by ID prefix or title substring.
Selection summary line at the bottom of the picker: 'N selected · ~N min est. · uniform harness'.
Confirm and Cancel buttons: Confirm commits to .mp/autopilot-state.json::setup.milestones and closes; Cancel closes without committing.
Narrow-terminal fallback: when the terminal width is < 100 cols, the picker renders as a full-screen modal at the SAME widget level — same internal state, different renderer (~50 LOC extra).
100ms cyan pulse on the Start button after Confirm — animation timing wrapper with a one-shot 100ms tick; renders in the idle split view's Start button before the While-Executing takeover fires.

Mouse Model B (free click + focus) — click anywhere on a row toggles, click on a checkbox toggles without row focus change, click outside dimmed-backdrop closes (with a 2-click-to-close confirmation to avoid accidental dismissals).
Keyboard: j/k move row, gg/G top/bottom, space / x toggle, 1/2/3/4 switch filter chip, / focus search, esc or click-outside cancels.

Edge cases: 0-matches shows 'No milestones match the filter' with Confirm disabled; empty selection at Confirm shows a one-line 'no milestones selected — Start will be disabled' warning requiring a second click to dismiss; in-progress milestones show a '↳ stale' badge (can't be re-picked).
Selected items disabled in completed state (cannot re-pick).
out_of_scope: Geometry + sidebar + While-Executing takeover (M241 — comes first).
Recent-runs UI (deferred to a future milestone per Q5).
Picker animations beyond the 100ms Start-pulse (no slide-down for now; defer to a polish milestone).

acceptance_criteria.description: Picker opens as a floating center overlay anchored to the middle 2/3 of the screen; backdrop dims the surrounding setup + sidebar regions to 30% opacity.
Multi-select via checkboxes toggles selection state; pressing space or x on a focused row toggles; click on a checkbox toggles without row focus change.
Selection persists across filter changes; switching from 'ready-only' to 'all' keeps the previously selected items selected.
4 filter chips (all / ready-only / in-progress / complete) mutually exclusive; switching updates the visible list; in-progress / complete rows are not selectable.
'/' search box focuses on '/' keypress (when picker is open); typing filters by ID prefix and title substring; empty state shown when no matches.
Selection summary line: 'N selected · ~N min est. · uniform harness' updates live as selection changes; 0 selected disables Confirm with a one-line warning.
Confirm commits selection to .mp/autopilot-state.json::setup.milestones and closes the picker; Cancel closes without committing; both are wired to the existing planner state read on Start.
On terminal width < 100 cols, the picker renders as a full-screen modal at the SAME widget level — same internal state, different renderer; tested by passing a small terminal width fixture.

100ms cyan pulse on the Start button after Confirm — animation fires for ~100ms, then the screen transitions to While-Executing (which M241 owns); the pulse is implemented as a one-shot animation tick in view_state.
Outside-click dismissal: first outside click dims the picker further and adds a 'click again to close' hint; second outside click closes the picker; Cancel still available.
make lint + make test + consumer-surface-lint remain green; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings exits 0.
acceptance_criteria.verification: make lint && make test && make consumer-surface-lint

work_packages.name: Floating picker widget
work_packages.goal: Floating center overlay anchored to middle 2/3 of screen; dimmed backdrop to 30%; multi-select backend; checkbox toggle; selection persists across filter changes; filter chips + search.
work_packages.rollback: Drop the floating widget; restore the existing milestone-lane sub-pane picker.

work_packages.name: Confirm cancel + state commit
work_packages.goal: Confirm commits to .mp/autopilot-state.json setup milestones and closes picker; Cancel closes without committing. Summary line live-updates. Outside-click two-step dismissal.
work_packages.rollback: Revert to a single-confirm no-state-commit behavior on Cancel.

work_packages.name: Narrow terminal fallback
work_packages.goal: On terminals narrower than 100 cols, the same internal state renders as a full-screen modal at the same widget level. ~50 LOC extra.
work_packages.rollback: Disable the modal fallback; picker only works on wide terminals.

work_packages.name: Start-pulse animation
work_packages.goal: 100ms cyan pulse on the Start button after Confirm; one-shot animation tick in view_state; transitions to While-Executing (M241) afterward.
work_packages.rollback: Disable the pulse; transition is instantaneous.

steps.action: Implement the floating picker overlay widget. Anchored to middle 2/3 of screen. Backdrop dims surrounding setup + sidebar to 30. Multi-select backend with checkbox toggle. Selection persists across filter changes.
Implement 4 filter chips plus search focus. Empty state. in-progress and complete not selectable.
Implement the picker summary line: N selected + N min est + uniform harness. Live-updates as selection changes. Zero selection disables Confirm with one-line warning requiring second click.
Implement Confirm and Cancel buttons. Confirm commits to state.json setup milestones and closes picker; Cancel closes without committing. Outside-click two-step dismissal.

Implement the narrow-terminal fallback renderer. When terminal width < 100 cols the picker renders as a full-screen modal at the SAME widget level. Same internal state different renderer. ~50 LOC extra.
Implement the 100ms cyan pulse animation on the Start button after Confirm. One-shot animation tick in view_state.
Run make lint plus make test plus consumer-surface-lint plus cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; ensure no regressions.
